escalations.title: Handlebars.js JavaScript Injection via AST Type Confusion (CVSS 9.8)
escalations.description: Handlebars 4.7.8 is vulnerable to JavaScript injection when untrusted input is passed to template rendering. Five separate GHSA advisories (CVSS 4.7–9.8). Fix: npm update handlebars to 4.7.9+. Security team must confirm whether handlebars is used with untrusted input before production deployment.

p1_findings.title: GET /api/search route not implemented — 5 tests intentionally fail
p1_findings.description: No Source/Backend/src/routes/search.ts and no app.use('/api/search') in app.ts. Five test cases document the expected contract and explicitly note they will fail until the route is implemented. DependencyPicker.tsx calls searchItems() which hits this missing endpoint at runtime — live typeahead is broken.
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: Any user of the DependencyPicker UI triggers a 404 on every keystroke in the search box. TypeAhead dependency linking is non-functional.
p1_findings.impact: Core dependency-linking feature (FR-dependency-search) non-functional in UI. 5 failing tests blocking CI.
p1_findings.recommendation: Create Source/Backend/src/routes/search.ts implementing GET /api/search?q= that filters workItemStore.findAll() by title/description (case-insensitive), excludes soft-deleted items, returns {data: WorkItem[]}. Mount in app.ts. Unblocks 5 failing tests.

p1_findings.title: Traceability enforcer false green — 69 Specifications requirements completely unchecked
p1_findings.description: The enforcer auto-selects Plans/self-judging-workflow/requirements.md (13 FR-WF-* IDs), all of which pass. Specifications/dev-workflow-platform.md defines 69 formal FR-001–069 requirements. Source code has zero // Verifies: FR-001 through FR-069 comments. The mandatory CLAUDE.md verification gate passes with zero true signal on the main specification document.
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: Any regression against the 69 Specifications requirements is invisible to CI. The gate says PASS while the entire Specifications spec is untested.
p1_findings.impact: Architecture rule 'Every FR needs a test with Verifies: FR-XXX' is unverifiable. False compliance.
p1_findings.recommendation: Extend enforcer to also scan Specifications/ for requirement IDs. Alternatively, declare dev-workflow-platform.md as historical and formally retire FR-001–069 from the enforcer scope. Either way: PASS must not occur when the authoritative spec is untested.

p1_findings.title: Handlebars.js 4.7.8 — JavaScript Injection CVSS 9.8 + 7 additional CVEs
p1_findings.description: handlebars@4.7.8 (transitive dep in Source/Backend) carries 5 GHSA advisories: GHSA-2w6w-674q-4c4q (CVSS 9.8, JS injection via AST type confusion), GHSA-3mfm-83xf-c92r (CVSS 8.1, @partial-block tampering), GHSA-2qvq-rjwj-gvw9 (CVSS 4.7, prototype pollution XSS), GHSA-9cx6-37pm-9jff (CVSS 7.5, DoS), GHSA-xjpj-3mr7-gcpf (CVSS 8.2, CLI precompiler injection).
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: If any code path in Source/Backend renders a Handlebars template with untrusted user input (e.g., email templates, report generation), an attacker can inject and execute arbitrary JavaScript server-side.
p1_findings.impact: Remote code execution on server if untrusted input reaches Handlebars template engine.
p1_findings.recommendation: 1. IMMEDIATE: cd Source/Backend && npm update handlebars (→ 4.7.9+). 2. TheGuardians must confirm whether handlebars is used with untrusted input. 3. Consider migrating to a modern template engine (nunjucks, mustache) — Handlebars has recurring injection CVEs.

p1_findings.title: Vitest ≤4.1.0-beta.6 — critical vulnerability in test framework (3 workspaces)
p1_findings.description: vitest@≤4.1.0-beta.6 has a critical vulnerability allowing arbitrary code execution during CI/CD or local test runs. Affects Source/Frontend, portal/Backend, and portal/Frontend as a direct dependency.
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: Malicious code in test fixtures or CI environment can exploit the vitest vulnerability to execute arbitrary code during test runs.
p1_findings.impact: CI/CD pipeline integrity compromised. Arbitrary code execution risk on developer machines and build servers.
p1_findings.recommendation: Update vitest to stable 4.1.0+ in all three affected workspaces. Run full test suite after each update to verify compatibility.

p1_findings.title: protobufjs ≤7.5.7 — Remote Code Execution via malformed protobuf
p1_findings.description: protobufjs@≤7.5.7 (transitive in platform/orchestrator) has a known RCE vulnerability. Parsing a malicious protobuf message can trigger arbitrary code execution.
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: An attacker who can send malformed protobuf messages to the orchestrator can achieve remote code execution.
p1_findings.impact: Remote code execution in platform/orchestrator — the pipeline infrastructure itself.
p1_findings.recommendation: cd platform/orchestrator && npm update protobufjs (→ 7.6.0+). Test orchestrator functionality after update.

p2_findings.title: Spec ID namespace disconnect — FR-001–069 unreachable by any code comment
p2_findings.description: Two parallel requirement namespaces exist: FR-001–069 (Specifications/dev-workflow-platform.md, never used in Source/) and FR-WF-001–013 / FR-dependency-* (Plans/, used extensively). Specs/dev-workflow-platform.md describes a different domain (SQLite, FeatureRequest/BugReport entities) from what's implemented (in-memory WorkItems). CLAUDE.md's architecture rule about Verifies: FR-XXX cannot be verified against Specifications/ at all.
p2_findings.recommendation: Decision required: (a) Declare Specifications/dev-workflow-platform.md as historical; add FR-WF-* and FR-dependency-* IDs to Specifications/workflow-engine.md as the live spec. OR (b) Retrofit source with // Verifies: FR-XXX alias comments. FR-dependency-* must have a canonical spec home.

p2_findings.title: FR-dependency-seed not implemented — dependency data empty on every restart
p2_findings.description: FR-dependency-seed requires idempotent seeding of known dependency relationships on server startup. No seed function exists in Source/Backend/. In-memory store starts empty every restart; DependencySection has nothing to show in demo/dev scenarios. Integration testing of dependency features is harder with no seed data.
p2_findings.recommendation: Either (a) implement an idempotent startup seed in workItemStore.ts (3–5 WI-XXX items with dependency links), or (b) formally scope FR-dependency-seed as portal-only and update the spec. If implemented, must be idempotent (no duplicates on restart).

p3_findings.title: Traceability enforcer regex extracts false-positive IDs from prose
